breakdown.description: A positive Hall coefficient indicates hole-dominated conduction in the simple one-carrier picture.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that a positive Hall coefficient indicates holes as the majority carriers (p-type material), explicitly disregarding the incorrect claim from the incomplete prompt that electrons are the majority carriers. This aligns with the ground truth, which asks to determine the carrier type purely from the sign of R_H without any contradictory pre-assumption about electron dominance.
